options: Bobby brought the blocks because Bob asked for them.
Bobby played with the blocks to make Bob feel better.
Bobby did not know that Bob was sick.
Bobby wanted to build the tower all by himself.
Bobby put the elephant block on top because it was his favorite.
questions.question:
다음 글을 읽고 바비의 행동에 대해 추론할 수 있는 것은?

Bob came back home after a few months. He just lay in bed without talking or moving. After a while, Bobby came into Bob's room with the blocks.

"Bob, it's time to build a tower!"
Bob's mouth made a small smile. Bobby began to build the tower.
"Okay, Bob, now the elephant block."
Suddenly, Bob made a small sound like sneezing. At that moment, Bobby realized that Bob would recover soon. And Bob did. Slowly, Bob began to talk a little and move his fingers. But he still couldn't walk.
questions.explanation: 본문에서 Bobby가 Bob의 방에 블록을 가지고 들어가 'Bob, it's time to build a tower!'라고 말하고 탑을 짓는 활동을 했으며, 이를 통해 Bob이 미소 짓게 되고 회복의 신호를 보이게 된다. 이는 Bobby가 Bob의 기분을 좋게 해주기 위해 블록으로 놀았다는 것을 나타낸다.

options: Bob suddenly started to run fast.
It was surprising and wonderful that Bob moved his foot.
Bobby used real magic to make Bob walk.
Bob did not want to move his foot, but Bobby forced him.
Bob was only pretending to walk.
questions.question:
다음 글을 읽고 "Like magic"의 의미로 추론할 수 있는 것은?

"You taught me how to walk. Do you remember?" Bobby said.
Then, Bob stood up very slowly. Bobby smiled and stood in front of Bob. Bob leaned on Bobby's shoulders.
Bobby said, "When I was little, you held my hands and said these words." And Bobby added, "Now one foot."
Like magic, Bob moved one foot.
"Now the other."
And Bob moved the other.
Bob suddenly started to run fast.
questions.explanation: "Like magic"은 놀랍고 신기한 일이 마술처럼 일어났다는 비유적 표현이다. Bob이 움직일 수 없었던 다리를 갑자기 움직이게 된 것이 마술처럼 신기하고 놀라운 일이었다는 의미이다.

options: They were close friends who enjoyed spending time together.
They were new friends who were just getting to know each other.
They were teachers and students studying how to build towers.
They often argued about how to play with blocks.
They were both learning how to walk for the first time.
questions.question:
다음 글을 통해 추론할 수 있는 Bob과 Bobby의 관계로 가장 적절한 것은?

Bobby got his name from his grandfather, Bob. Bob was his best friend. Bob was the person who taught Bobby how to walk. "Hold my hands, Bobby," Bob said.
"Now one foot, now other."
Bob and Bobby often played with old wooden blocks. They slowly piled the blocks one by one to build a tower.
"There is one more block to put," Bob said.
"And that's the elephant block," Bobby said.
Bobby carefully put the elephant block on the top. But Bob sneezed, and the tower fell. Bobby laughed and laughed. Bobby said, "You always sneeze when the elephant block appears."
questions.explanation: 본문에서 Bobby는 할아버지 Bob으로부터 이름을 받았고, Bob이 자신의 가장 친한 친구(best friend)이며, 오래 전부터 함께 블록을 가지고 놀았고, 서로를 잘 알고 있으며 함께 시간을 보내는 것을 즐기는 모습이 드러난다.

options: 수빈이는 Kate의 생일 선물을 준비하고 있다.
아빠는 4시 이전에 수빈이를 도와줄 시간이 있다.
수빈이가 만들 쿠키는 케이트가 좋아하는 종류이다.
아빠는 4시에 케이트의 생일 파티에 가야 한다.
아빠와 수빈이는 곧 쿠키를 만들기 시작할 것이다.
questions.question:
다음 대화를 읽고 추론할 수 있는 내용으로 적절하지 않은 것은?

Subin: Dad, is it okay if I use the oven to bake some cookies?
Dad: Sure, you can, Subin. What are they for?
Subin: Today is Kate's birthday, so I want to bake them for her.
Dad: That's very nice of you. What time is it now?
Subin: It's a quarter past two.
Dad: I have an online meeting at 4, so I can help you now.
Subin: That's great!
Dad: What kind of cookies are you going to bake?
Subin: Cheese cookies. Kate loves them.
Dad: Okay. Let's start.
questions.explanation: 본문에서 아빠가 4시에 온라인 회의가 있다고만 했지, 4시에 케이트의 생일 파티에 간다는 언급은 전혀 없다. 따라서 4번이 적절하지 않은 추론이다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 우리말 (A)와 일치하도록 조건에 맞춰 영작했을 때, 6번째 올 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

Bob came back home after a few months. He just lay in bed without talking or moving. After a while, Bobby came into Bob's room with the blocks. "Bob, it's time to build a tower!" Bob's mouth made a small smile. Bobby began to build the tower. "Okay, Bob, now the elephant block." Suddenly, Bob made a small sound like sneezing.
(A) 그 순간, Bobby는 Bob이 곧 회복하리라는 것을 깨달았다.
And Bob did. Slowly, Bob began to talk a little and move his fingers. But he still couldn't walk.

<조건>
- 아래 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성할 것. (총 10단어)
- 단어: realized / At / that / would / moment, / soon / recover / Bobby / Bob / that
questions.explanation: 올바른 문장 순서는 'At that moment, Bobby realized that Bob would recover soon.'이다. 6번째 단어는 'that'이다.

options: 아빠는 4시에 있을 온라인 회의가 취소되었기 때문에
아빠는 4시 회의가 시작되기 전까지 시간이 있기 때문에
아빠는 케이트의 생일 파티에 수빈이와 함께 가야 하기 때문에
아빠는 수빈이가 치즈 쿠키 만드는 것을 매우 좋아하기 때문에
아빠는 오늘 온라인 회의 외에 다른 일정이 전혀 없기 때문에
questions.question:
다음 대화를 읽고 아빠가 지금 수빈이를 도울 수 있는 이유로 가장 적절한 것은?

Subin: Dad, is it okay if I use the oven to bake some cookies?
Dad: Sure, you can, Subin. What are they for?
Subin: Today is Kate's birthday, so I want to bake them for her.
Dad: That's very nice of you. What time is it now?
Subin: It's a quarter past two.
Dad: I have an online meeting at 4, so I can help you now.
Subin: That's great!
Dad: What kind of cookies are you going to bake?
Subin: Cheese cookies. Kate loves them.
Dad: Okay. Let's start.
questions.explanation: 아빠는 "I have an online meeting at 4, so I can help you now."라고 말했다. 현재 시간이 2시 15분(a quarter past two)이고 4시 회의가 있으므로, 4시까지 시간이 있어서 지금 수빈이를 도울 수 있다는 의미이다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 우리말 (A)와 일치하도록 조건에 맞춰 영작했을 때, 7번째 올 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

Time passed. One day, Bobby's dad looked very sad. He told Bobby, "Bob fell ill. (A) 그는 여기에서 멀리 떨어진 병원에 있단다." "I want to see him," Bobby said. "You can't, Bobby," Mom told him. "He can't move his arms and legs, and he can't talk. We'll just have to wait and hope that he will get better."

<조건>
- 아래 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성할 것. (총 10단어)
- 단어: a / He / in / hospital / is / which / far / is / from / here
questions.explanation: 올바른 문장 순서는 'He is in a hospital which is far from here.'이다. 7번째 단어는 'which'이다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 문맥상 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

Bobby got his name from his grandfather, Bob. Bob was his best friend. Bob was the person who ⓐ taught Bobby how to walk.
"Hold my hands, Bobby," Bob said.
"Now one foot, now the other."
Bob and Bobby often ⓑ played with old wooden blocks. They slowly ⓒ piled the blocks one by one to build a tower.
"There is one more block to put," Bob said.
"And that's the elephant block," Bobby said.
Bobby carefully put the elephant block on the top. But Bob ⓓ sneezed, and the tower fell. Bobby ⓔ cried and cried.
Bobby said, "You always sneeze when the elephant block appears."
questions.explanation: ⓔ 'cried and cried'는 문맥상 적절하지 않다. 본문 앞부분에서 'Bobby laughed and laughed'라고 명시되어 있으므로, ⓔ는 'cried'가 아니라 'laughed'여야 한다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?

When the weather got nice and warm, Bob and Bobby sat side by side. The summer breeze with the smell of happiness ⓐ was blowing. "You taught me how to walk. Do you remember?" Bobby said.
Then, Bob stood up very slowly. Bobby smiled and stood in front of Bob. Bob leaned on Bobby's shoulders. Bobby said, "When I was little, you ⓑ held my hands and ⓒ said these words." And Bobby added, "Now one foot." ⓓ Alike magic, Bob moved one foot. "Now the other." And Bob ⓔ moved the other.
questions.explanation: ⓓ 'Alike magic'은 어법상 적절하지 않다. 올바른 표현은 'Like magic'이어야 한다. 'Alike'는 형용사/부사로 '유사한'의 의미이지만, 여기서는 '마술처럼'의 의미로 'Like'를 사용해야 한다.

questions.question:
다음 글에서 전체 흐름과 관계 없는 문장은?

Bobby got his name from his grandfather, Bob. Bob was his best friend. Bob was the person who taught Bobby how to walk. "Hold my hands, Bobby," Bob said. "Now one foot, now the other." Bob and Bobby often played with old wooden blocks. They slowly piled the blocks one by one to build a tower. "There is one more block to put," Bob said. "And that's the elephant block," Bobby said. Bobby carefully put the elephant block on the top. ① There is one more block to put. ② And that's the elephant block. ③ Bobby carefully put the elephant block on the top. ④ Blocks are very popular toys all around the world. ⑤ But Bob sneezed, and the tower fell. Bobby laughed and laughed. Bobby said, "You always sneeze when the elephant block appears."
questions.explanation: ④ 'Blocks are very popular toys all around the world.'는 Bob과 Bobby의 관계와 블록으로 탑을 짓는 이야기의 흐름과 관계없는 문장이다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?

Bobby got his name (A)__________ his grandfather, Bob. Bob was his best friend. Bob was the person who taught Bobby how to walk. "Hold my hands, Bobby," Bob said. "Now one foot, now the other." Bob and Bobby often played (B)__________ old wooden blocks. They slowly piled the blocks one by one to build a tower. "There is one more block to put," Bob said. "And that's the elephant block," Bobby said. Bobby carefully put the elephant block (C)__________ the top. But Bob sneezed, and the tower fell.
questions.explanation:
(A) 'get one's name from ~' = ~에서 이름을 얻다 (from)
(B) 'play with ~' = ~과 함께 놀다 (with)
(C) 'on the top' = 위 쪽에 (on)

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 우리말 (A)와 일치하도록 조건에 맞춰 영작했을 때, 7번째 올 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

B: Mom, is it okay if I use your computer?
W: What do you need it for?
B: (A) 숙제를 위한 정보를 좀 찾아야 해요.
W: Okay, but I need to use the computer in the evening.
B: Don't worry. I'll finish before then.

<조건>
- 아래 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성할 것. (총 9단어)
- 단어: my / information / I / homework / for / find / need / to / some
questions.explanation:
정렬된 문장: I need to find some information for my homework.
1-need 2-to 3-find 4-some 5-information 6-for 7-my 8-homework
7번째 단어는 'my'이다.

options: It is important to remember Bob.
Mom told him, but he didn't hear it.
questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 (A) It과 쓰임이 같은 것은?

Bob came back home after a few months. He just lay in bed without talking or moving. After a while, Bobby came into Bob's room with the blocks. "Bob, (A) It's time to build a tower!" Bob's mouth made a small smile. Bobby began to build the tower. "Okay, Bob, now the elephant block." Suddenly, Bob made a small sound like sneezing. At that moment, Bobby realized that Bob would recover soon. And Bob did. Slowly, Bob began to talk a little and move his fingers. But he still couldn't walk.
questions.explanation: (A) 'It's time to ~'는 '~할 시간이다'라는 의미로, 가목적 it 용법이다. 같은 가목적 it 용법은 "It is important to remember Bob."이다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 가장 적절한 것은?

When the weather (A) [got / getting] nice and warm, Bob and Bobby sat side by side. The summer breeze with the smell of happiness was blowing. "You taught me how to walk. Do you remember?" Bobby said. Then, Bob stood up very slowly. Bobby (B) [smiled / smiling] and stood in front of Bob. Bob leaned on Bobby's shoulders. Bobby said, "When I was little, you held my hands and said these words." And Bobby (C) [added / adding], "Now one foot."
questions.explanation:
(A) When절에서 과거시제로 'got'이 맞다.
(B) 주어 Bobby와 술어 stood가 있으므로 'smiled'(과거형)가 맞다.
(C) 병렬 구조로 'said'와 같은 과거형이므로 'added'가 맞다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 우리말 (A)와 일치하도록 조건에 맞춰 영작했을 때, 9번째 올 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

Bob came back home after a few months. He just lay in bed without talking or moving. (A) 잠시 후, Bobby는 블록을 가지고 Bob의 방으로 들어왔다. "Bob, it's time to build a tower!" Bob's mouth made a small smile. Bobby began to build the tower. "Okay, Bob, now the elephant block." Suddenly, Bob made a small sound like sneezing. At that moment, Bobby realized that Bob would recover soon.

<조건>
- 아래 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성할 것. (총 11단어)
- 단어: a / room / with / Bobby / Bob's / into / came / After / the / while, / blocks
questions.explanation:
정렬된 문장: After a while, Bobby came into Bob's room with the blocks.
1-After 2-a 3-while 4-Bobby 5-came 6-into 7-Bob's 8-room 9-with 10-the 11-blocks
9번째 단어는 'with'이다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 우리말 (A)와 일치하도록 조건에 맞춰 영작했을 때, 4번째 올 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

Bobby got his name from his grandfather, Bob. Bob was his best friend. (A) Bob은 Bobby에게 걷는 법을 가르쳐준 사람이었다. "Hold my hands, Bobby," Bob said. "Now one foot, now the other." Bob and Bobby often played with old wooden blocks. They slowly piled the blocks one by one to build a tower. "There is one more block to put," Bob said. "And that's the elephant block," Bobby said. Bobby carefully put the elephant block on the top. But Bob sneezed, and the tower fell.

<조건>
- 아래 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성할 것. (총 10단어)
- 단어: the / person / walk / taught / who / to / Bobby / how / Bob / was
questions.explanation:
정렬된 문장: Bob was the person who taught Bobby how to walk.
1-Bob 2-was 3-the 4-person 5-who 6-taught 7-Bobby 8-how 9-to 10-walk
4번째 단어는 'person'이다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 가장 적절한 것은?

B: Hey, I'm Tim. Where am I? I'm at Adventure Land with my dad! We're (A) [going to have / going to having] fun here. It's ten o'clock. We are standing in line to ride a roller coaster. I'm so excited! ... It's already half past ten. We'll ride the roller coaster. Let's go! Ahhhh! ... I'm back! We're (B) [going / go] to have lunch. Everything (C) [looks / looking] delicious! I'll have spaghetti. I'll be back soon.
questions.explanation:
(A) 'be going to + 동사원형'의 형태로 'going to have'가 맞다.
(B) 'We're going to have lunch'에서 'going'이 맞다.
(C) Everything은 3인칭 단수이므로 'looks'가 맞다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 가장 적절한 것은?

W: Hello, Eric. How are you doing?
B: I'm doing okay, thanks. (A) [How's / How] your trip to London, Grandma?
W: It's great. I went to Big Ben and (B) [had / have] a meat pie yesterday.
B: Wow! You're having a great time there. By the way, what time is it in London now?
W: It's a quarter past six in the morning.
B: Oh, you (C) [woke up / wake up] early! I hope you have a wonderful vacation there.
questions.explanation:
(A) 'How is' = 'How's'로 축약된 형태가 맞다.
(B) 'went'와 'yesterday' 때문에 과거형 'had'가 맞다.
(C) 'woke up'(과거형)이 맞다.

options: And he taught Bobby how to walk
And the tower fell and Bobby laughed
And Bob moved one foot, now the other
But he was in a hospital far from here
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

Bob came back home after a few months. He just lay in bed without talking or moving. After a while, Bobby came into Bob's room with the blocks. "Bob, it's time to build a tower!" Bob's mouth made a small smile. Bobby began to build the tower. "Okay, Bob, now the elephant block." Suddenly, Bob made a small sound like sneezing. At that moment, Bobby realized that Bob would get better soon. And Bob did. Slowly, Bob began to talk a little and move his fingers.
_____________________________.
questions.explanation: 문맥상 Bob이 회복되고 있지만 아직 완전히 걷지 못한다는 내용이 이어져야 하므로 'But he still couldn't walk'이 가장 적절하다.

options: The boy will go to the baseball game today.
Uncle John will come at eight o'clock.
The boy knew about the dinner with Uncle John.
The mom suggested going to the next game.
The mom is angry at the boy.

다음 대화의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

B: Mom, is it okay if I go to see a baseball game this evening?
W: I'm afraid you can't. We're going to have dinner with Uncle John today.
B: Oh, is it today? I didn't know that.
W: He'll be here at six. How about going to the next game?
B: Sure, I'll check the time of the next game.
W: Okay.
questions.explanation: 대화에서 엄마가 "How about going to the next game?"라고 제안했으므로 "The mom suggested going to the next game."이 맞다.

options: Bob과 Bobby는 함께 블록으로 탑을 만들기를 좋아했다.
Bob은 코끼리 블록이 나타나면 항상 재채기를 했다.
Bobby는 Bob의 작은 코 소리를 통해 Bob이 곧 회복될 것을 깨달았다.
Bob은 이야기 끝에서 완전히 걸을 수 있게 되었다.
questions.question:
다음 글을 읽고 'Bob'과 'Bobby'에 관해 알 수 있는 내용으로 적절하지 않은 것은?

Bob and Bobby often played with old wooden blocks. They slowly piled the blocks one by one to build a tower. "There is one more block to put," Bob said. "And that's the elephant block," Bobby said. Bobby carefully put the elephant block on the top. But Bob sneezed, and the tower fell. Bobby laughed and laughed. Bobby said, "You always sneeze when the elephant block appears." Bob came back home after a few months. He just lay in bed without talking or moving. After a while, Bobby came into Bob's room with the blocks. "Bob, it's time to build a tower!" Bob's mouth made a small smile. Bobby began to build the tower. "Okay, Bob, now the elephant block." Suddenly, Bob made a small sound like sneezing. At that moment, Bobby realized that Bob would recover soon. And Bob did. Slowly, Bob began to talk a little and move his fingers. But he still couldn't walk.
questions.explanation: 마지막 문장에서 "But he still couldn't walk."이라고 명확히 나와있으므로 Bob이 완전히 걷을 수 있게 되었다는 내용은 적절하지 않다.

options: 탑이 무너질 때마다 Bobby에게 화를 냈다.
questions.question:
[지문]
Bobby got his name from his grandfather, Bob. Bob was his best friend. Bob was the person who taught Bobby how to walk. "Hold my hands, Bobby," Bob said. "Now one foot, now the other." Bob and Bobby often played with old wooden blocks. They slowly piled the blocks one by one to build a tower. "There is one more block to put," Bob said. "And that's the elephant block," Bobby said. Bobby carefully put the elephant block on the top. But Bob sneezed, and the tower fell. Bobby laughed and laughed. Bobby said, "You always sneeze when the elephant block appears."

다음 글을 읽고 'Bob'에 대해 알 수 있는 내용으로 옳은 것은?
questions.explanation: 지문에서 "Bob was the person who taught Bobby how to walk"라고 명시되어 있으므로, Bob이 Bobby에게 걸음마를 가르쳐 주었다는 내용이 맞다.

questions.question:
[지문]
(A) Bob and Bobby often played with old wooden blocks. They slowly piled the blocks one by one to build a tower. "There is one more block to put," Bob said. "And that's the elephant block," Bobby said. Bobby carefully put the elephant block on the top. But Bob sneezed, and the tower fell. Bobby laughed and laughed. Bobby said, "You always sneeze when the elephant block appears."

(B) Time passed. One day, Bobby's dad looked very sad. He told Bobby, "Bob fell ill. He is in a hospital which is far from here." "I want to see him," Bobby said. "You can't, Bobby," Mom told him. "He can't move his arms and legs, and he can't talk. We'll just have to wait and hope that he will get better."

다음 글 (A)와 (B)에 나타난 분위기의 변화로 가장 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: (A)에서는 두 사람이 함께 즐겁게 블록 놀이를 하며 웃는 분위기로 '기쁜 분위기(joyful)'이고, (B)에서는 Bob이 병에 걸려 병원에 입원했다는 슬픈 소식으로 '슬픈 분위기(sad)'로 변한다. 따라서 'joyful → sad'가 정답이다.

options: Bobby는 Bob에게 걸음마를 가르쳐 준 것을 기억하냐고 물었다.
Bobby는 어릴 때 들었던 말을 Bob에게 그대로 했다.
Bob은 Bobby의 도움 없이 혼자서 걷기 시작했다.
questions.question:
[지문]
When the weather got nice and warm, Bob and Bobby sat side by side. The summer breeze with the smell of happiness was blowing. "You taught me how to walk. Do you remember?" Bobby said. Then, Bob stood up very slowly. Bobby smiled and stood in front of Bob. Bob leaned on Bobby's shoulders. Bobby said, "When I was little, you held my hands and said these words." And Bobby added, "Now one foot." Like magic, Bob moved one foot. "Now the other." And Bob moved the other.

다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
questions.explanation: 지문에서 'Bob leaned on Bobby's shoulders'라고 명시되어 있고, 'Like magic, Bob moved one foot'는 Bobby의 말과 도움으로 발을 움직인 것이다. 따라서 Bob이 Bobby의 도움 없이 혼자서 걷기 시작했다는 내용은 일치하지 않는다.

options: The Best Friends: Bob and Bobby
How to Build a Tall Tower
questions.question:
[지문]
Bobby got his name from his grandfather, Bob. Bob was his best friend. Bob was the person who taught Bobby how to walk. "Hold my hands, Bobby," Bob said. "Now one foot, now the other." Bob and Bobby often played with old wooden blocks. They slowly piled the blocks one by one to build a tower. "There is one more block to put," Bob said. "And that's the elephant block," Bobby said. Bobby carefully put the elephant block on the top. But Bob sneezed, and the tower fell. Bobby laughed and laughed. Bobby said, "You always sneeze when the elephant block appears."

다음 글의 제목으로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 이 글은 Bobby가 할아버지 Bob으로부터 이름을 얻었고, Bob이 걸음마를 가르쳐주었으며, 함께 블록 놀이를 하며 즐거운 시간을 보냈다는 두 사람의 친한 관계를 중심으로 서술하고 있다. 따라서 '가장 친한 친구: Bob과 Bobby'가 가장 적절한 제목이다.
